policy_prompt_for_subgoal: An episode starts in A (press the button): the first step shows the three loose cubes and no containers. Rule 1: if the step shows loose cubes and no containers anywhere and nothing held, choose A (press the button); at the same time record each cube's position in the memory fields. Rule 2: if the step shows containers on the table and the gripper is NOT holding a container, choose B (pick up the container). The target is the cube named in the goal at position picks_done+1 in the goal's order (first named cube when picks_done is 0, second named cube when picks_done is 1). Look up that cube's recorded position (blue_cube_pos / green_cube_pos / red_cube_pos) and point at the center of the container nearest to that recorded position, writing the point as [y, x]. Ignore containers that cover no recorded cube. Rule 3: if the step shows a container held in the gripper, choose C (put down the container). After that, Rule 2 applies again with the next cube in the goal. If all cubes named in the goal have already been picked (picks_done equals the number of cubes named), choose C if holding, otherwise B at the container nearest the last named cube. Unforeseen situation: if a container is held, choose C; if containers are visible and nothing is held, choose B at the container nearest the recorded position of the next goal cube; if no containers are visible, choose A.

fields.name: blue_cube_pos
fields.description: If this step shows a loose blue cube and no containers (the scene before the button is pressed), write the blue cube's [y, x] as shown. Otherwise copy the carried-in value unchanged; never overwrite it from a cube briefly exposed under a lifted container. e.g. [128, 141]

fields.name: green_cube_pos
fields.description: If this step shows a loose green cube and no containers (the scene before the button is pressed), write the green cube's [y, x] as shown. Otherwise copy the carried-in value unchanged. e.g. [88, 106]

fields.name: red_cube_pos
fields.description: If this step shows a loose red cube and no containers (the scene before the button is pressed), write the red cube's [y, x] as shown. Otherwise copy the carried-in value unchanged. e.g. [130, 79]

fields.name: picks_done
fields.description: Number of container pick-ups completed. Start at 0. If any execution step shown at this decision step says a container is held in the gripper, write carried-in value + 1; otherwise copy the carried-in value. e.g. 1
